steps: Open a new Qtrade Direct Investing account at qtrade.ca by January 5, 2027, entering promo code OFFER2026 during the application
Fund the account by February 5, 2027 with at least C$1,000 (more funding = higher tier, up to C$5,000 cash back)
Keep all new deposits in the account until February 5, 2028 - any withdrawals or transfers out reduce or forfeit the bonus
Receive the cash back bonus credited to the account on or around March 5, 2028
